versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Investment Banking Specialist Roadmap platform.
- Generates personalized career development paths and specialization guidance for investment banking roles.
- Supports assessment of user experience, technical skills, and career goals to recommend learning paths and milestones.
- Offers endpoints for roadmap generation, specialization details, and learning path resources.
- Includes API health check and detailed documentation for seamless integration.
- Tiered pricing plans available for varying usage needs.
